title: Implement Phase 0 Engram host adapter
outcome: Add the opt-in shadow-only Engram host adapter for delegated sessions: persistent binding identity, off-lock evaluate/begin/checkpoint lifecycle, fail-open budgets and circuit breaker, structured control cards, restart recovery, and scripted/real-process transport tests.
acceptance: S1-S11 conformance scenarios pass; 250ms per-call and 600ms overall dispatch deadlines; project opt-in defaults off and validates explicit project file, binary, home, and doctor; no routing token appears in wire/transcript/card/mailbox; all relevant backend quality gates pass.
